home.description: Workspace Library overview with sidebar navigation, Collections, and the draft grid.

nodes.title: Template editor
nodes.notes: Opened from Brand Kit > Templates > New Template; editor remains under workspace sidebar.

nodes.title: Draft editor
nodes.notes: Opened by New draft or selecting a draft.

nodes.title: Add Music / selected track
options: [No Copyright Music] Chill LoFi Hip Hop Beat FREE (Copyright Free) Music_ LAKEY …
ES_A Winter to Remember - Trevor Kowalski

nodes.title: Add Reference...
nodes.notes: Composer actions; opens standard macOS Open dialog.

nodes.title: Make a copy
nodes.notes: Creates and opens a duplicate named “Copy of <title>”.

nodes.title: Delete scene
nodes.notes: Deletes scene content.

nodes.title: Upload Camera Footage
nodes.notes: Opens upload/file-selection flow.

nodes.title: Version History
nodes.notes: Right-side panel listing older versions with time/author; revert is document-destructive but can be undone.

nodes.title: Brand
nodes.notes: Project actions submenu; assigns the brand kit used by this document.

nodes.title: Text Style Toolbar
nodes.notes: Toggled by unlabeled toolbar button next to project background.

nodes.title: Copy Transcript
nodes.notes: Copies the draft transcript to clipboard; menu closes with no confirmation.

nodes.title: Download SRT...
nodes.notes: Exports subtitles; guarded by harness as file-writing/destructive descent.

nodes.title: Project aspect ratio
nodes.notes: In Project actions; selection immediately reshapes preview.

nodes.title: Performance Mode
nodes.notes: Under Project actions; choice applies immediately and closes menu.

nodes.title: Timeline Zoom
nodes.notes: Small popover with one continuous slider.

nodes.title: Timeline Zoom slider
nodes.notes: Continuous editor-view zoom; observed value ~0.65.

nodes.title: Brand Template Overlay picker
nodes.notes: Lists templates from the draft’s assigned brand and a New Blank Overlay create control.

nodes.title: New Blank Overlay
nodes.notes: Creates an overlay in the draft timeline.

nodes.title: Template thumbnail
nodes.notes: Applies a brand template as a draft overlay.

nodes.title: Overlay editing context
nodes.notes: Contextual state inside draft editor after creating/selecting an overlay; top toolbar shows Insert and overlay background controls.

nodes.title: Insert menu
nodes.notes: Overlay object menu.

nodes.title: Overlay text toolbar
nodes.notes: Contextual toolbar shown when an overlay text element is selected.

nodes.title: Text Style preset picker
nodes.notes: Lists Text Styles from the assigned Brand Kit; unlabeled popup immediately left of font family.

nodes.title: Overlay Image Picker
nodes.notes: Opened from overlay Insert > Image; full-window thumbnail grid, labels are largely absent.

nodes.title: Overlay Video Picker
nodes.notes: Duration-labeled video asset grid; selecting inserts library content.

nodes.title: Shape Width and Height
nodes.notes: W/H numeric fields, default 200×200 for rectangle.

nodes.title: Insert Ellipse
nodes.notes: Creates a 200×200 ellipse in the current scratch overlay; same inspector as Rectangle.

nodes.title: Linear gradient editor
nodes.notes: Gradient endpoints and stop list.

nodes.title: Gradient Stops
nodes.notes: Per-stop position, color/hex, opacity; flip, rotate, add and remove controls.

nodes.title: Radial gradient editor
nodes.notes: Same stop controls as Linear.

nodes.title: Multi-point gradient editor
nodes.notes: Color/opacity stops plus Blend value.

nodes.title: Image paint
nodes.notes: Upload image, then Fit and Position controls.

nodes.title: Image Fit
nodes.notes: Default Cover; disabled before upload.

nodes.title: Image Position
nodes.notes: Default Center; disabled before upload.

nodes.title: Shader paint
nodes.notes: Paint-type tab with preset and shader parameters.

nodes.title: Shader preset
nodes.notes: Combo box; observed Watercolor.

nodes.title: Shader Colors
nodes.notes: Editable Base, Mid Accent, Accent and one additional unlabeled swatch.

nodes.title: Shader Parameters
nodes.notes: Speed, Seed, Noise, Saturation numeric values.

nodes.title: Polygon overlay element
nodes.notes: Insert > Polygon; default 200×200, N=6.

nodes.title: Polygon sides (N)
nodes.notes: Numeric field; default 6.

nodes.title: Overlay Pen tool
nodes.notes: Insert > Pen; enters freehand drawing mode without an AX-labeled contextual toolbar.

nodes.title: Overlay group toolbar
nodes.notes: Appears after Insert > Group; includes arrangement, paint/stroke-like fields, opacity, Ungroup, options.

nodes.title: Duplicate Brand
nodes.notes: Creates an independent copy named '<original> Copy' and opens it.

nodes.title: New Brand
nodes.notes: Immediately creates blank Untitled Brand and opens its Brand Overview.

nodes.title: Rename Brand
nodes.notes: On a scratch/new brand, title edit shows a text field plus adjacent Done; replace the field value and click Done.

nodes.title: Make Default
nodes.notes: Immediate action from Brand options; no confirmation observed.

nodes.title: Brand assignment
nodes.notes: Project actions > Brand; selection applies immediately.

nodes.title: Collection
nodes.notes: Collection tiles appear above the Library grid; selecting one filters/opens that collection.

nodes.title: Draft card actions
nodes.notes: Unlabeled popup on each Library/Drafts card; treat destructive actions as document-content operations.

edges.action: launch Yarn, or click "Library" in the left sidebar
click a color swatch / Open paint picker
open Project actions, click “Screen Clip Settings...”
Project actions > Make a copy (opens duplicated draft)
Open Project actions and click “Show Version History...”
Open Project actions > Brand > Edit Brands…
Click the unlabeled toolbar button immediately right of project background
Project actions > Efficiency, Default, or Ultra
click the timeline toolbar popup labeled “Timeline Zoom”
click the first unlabeled 46px timeline-toolbar popup (immediately after the time readout)
click “New Blank Overlay” (creates an Overlay item in the scratch draft)
edit N in the polygon contextual toolbar
choose Duplicate Brand; copied brand opens immediately
choose New Brand; blank Untitled Brand opens
in the newly created Untitled Brand, click the large brand title, replace it, and click Done
open Project actions > Screen Clip Settings..., then use Cursor Clicks selector
open Project actions, hover/click Brand, select a brand
click the unlabeled popup on a draft card
click a draft card or its sidebar item
click "New Template" or select a template then "Edit Template..."
open Project actions, then "Screen Clip Settings..."
click the leftmost unlabeled timeline editing popup
